full_prompt_en: A square, densely detailed hand-drawn crowd illustration shows a bespectacled figure in red-and-white stripes near the center of an almost wall-to-wall gathering. The crowd fills the entire background and reaches every edge, so there is almost no open sky, ground, or architectural setting. At the upper edge, tiny heads and hats press into a busy mosaic of warm faces, cool blue clothing, and muted brown shapes. The striped figure stands slightly below the middle, larger and more clearly outlined than the surrounding people. A red-and-white banded cap sits above black-rimmed round glasses and a simple pale face. The matching striped shirt carries broad horizontal bands across the torso and narrow bands down the arms. One hand rises near the right side of the figure, with the fingers visibly separated, while the other arm angles down into the crowd. Around this bright center, overlapping people vary in height, expression, hair color, glasses, hats, and coat shapes. Most are rendered with small ink contours and pale washes, allowing individual faces to remain readable despite the very high density. Several heads in the immediate foreground partly hide bodies farther back. Reds recur throughout the group, but their scattered, smaller patches do not overpower the central stripes. Blue-green and gray clothing cools the field around the warm tan and peach faces. Dark brown line work records brows, noses, mouths, hat brims, and garment seams in quick, compact marks. The surface appears lightly textured like printed or painted paper, with limited smooth shading and no glossy highlights. Light is broadly even across the crowd, so hierarchy comes from scale, sharper contour, and saturated red rather than from a spotlight. There is no legible text in the selected image. The overall composition is deliberately crowded and playful, turning hundreds of tiny overlaps into a continuous visual search field around one crisp red-and-white focal figure.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、细节密集的手绘人群插画：一个穿红白条纹、戴眼镜的人物处在几乎填满画面的聚集人群中央。人群占据整个背景并延伸到各边缘，因此几乎看不到开阔天空、地面或建筑。上边缘，小小的人头与帽子挤成由暖色面孔、冷蓝色衣物和低调褐色形块构成的繁忙镶嵌。条纹人物位于中央稍下方，比周围的人更大，轮廓也更清楚。红白横纹帽子下是黑框圆眼镜和简单的浅色面孔。配套条纹上衣在躯干上形成宽横带，在手臂上则变成较窄的条带。一只手在人物右侧附近举起，手指可见分开；另一条手臂斜向下方，没入人群。围绕这个鲜明中心，重叠的人物有不同身高、神情、发色、眼镜、帽子和外套形状。大部分人物由细小墨线轮廓与浅色水洗描绘，即使密度很高，个别面孔仍可辨认。近景的几个头部部分遮挡后方身体。红色在整群人中反复出现，但散落的较小色块无法盖过中央条纹。蓝绿与灰色衣物冷却了暖棕、蜜桃色面孔之间的色域。深褐线条以快速紧凑的笔迹记录眉毛、鼻子、嘴、帽檐和衣缝。表面带有轻微的印刷或绘画纸张肌理，平滑塑形有限，也没有光滑亮斑。光线在人群上大致均匀，因此视觉层级来自尺度、更清楚的轮廓和饱和红色，而不是聚光灯。所选画面没有可读文字。整体构图刻意拥挤而俏皮，把数不尽的小小遮挡组织为围绕一个清晰红白焦点的连续视觉搜寻场。
style_prompt_en: Detailed ink-and-wash illustration builds a nearly continuous field from tightly packed, overlapping small forms. Many fine brown contours and quick interior marks keep individual units distinct even when the composition has almost no empty space. Warm tan, muted brown, cool blue-green, and gray make a varied low-to-medium contrast ground, while a small number of saturated red-and-white bands establish a sharper focal rhythm. Repeated shapes differ subtly in size and angle, producing lively visual search rather than a rigid grid. Soft paper-like color and modest shading retain a drawn, printed character. Illumination is broadly even; hierarchy comes from scale, contour clarity, and concentrated saturation. The overall effect is exuberant and meticulous, with high information density held together by recurring colors and linear detail.
style_prompt_zh: 细密的墨线与淡彩插画以紧挨、重叠的小形体构成几乎连续的色场。大量纤细褐色轮廓与快速内部笔迹，即使在几乎没有空白的构图中仍能区分单个单元。暖棕、低调褐色、冷蓝绿和灰色形成多变的中低反差底色，少量饱和红白条带则建立更鲜明的焦点节奏。重复形状的大小与角度略有差异，产生活跃的视觉搜寻感，而非僵硬网格。柔和的纸面色彩与有限塑形保留手绘和印刷般的特质。照明大体均匀，层级来自尺度、轮廓清晰度和集中饱和度。整体效果热闹而精细，极高的信息密度由反复出现的色彩和线性细节维系。
theme_en: A red-and-white striped figure hidden within an immense illustrated crowd
theme_zh: 身穿红白条纹的人物藏在庞大的插画人群中
name: Where is Waldo
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
